surfaces.label: Repository integrity and public assets
surfaces.notes: Verified clean signed revision, all 81 tracked files, beta.2 delta, aligned versions, allowlisted package, exact shrinkwrap integrity, pinned Actions, and five synthetic or branding-only PNGs.

surfaces.label: Database source, read-only open, and copy/live boundary
surfaces.notes: Reviewed canonical path and identity checks, pre-open live main/WAL alias rejection, readonly/fileMustExist/query_only SQLite, rollback-only snapshots, identity and version checks, lineage, and copy fingerprints. Evidence: src/database.ts:32-129,225-238,306-468,494-563.

surfaces.label: Schema capabilities and query repositories
surfaces.notes: Reviewed capability-gated parameterized SQL, bounded discovered identifiers, conversations, messages, analytics, sync, dates/DST, reactions, receipts, edits, retractions, service families, and keyset cursors.
surfaces.riskArea: SQL injection, attribution, completeness, and snapshot integrity

surfaces.label: HTTP authentication and transport limits
surfaces.notes: Reviewed loopback bind, bounded constant-time bearer verification before body parsing, Host/Origin checks, POST routing, size, socket, rate, two-call concurrency, and deadline limits. Evidence: src/transport.ts:15-24,38-71,91-168,225-355.

surfaces.label: Secret files, opaque references, and lineage
surfaces.notes: Reviewed exclusive secret sources, O_NOFOLLOW, ownership, mode 0600, file and size checks, independent keys, lineage-derived AES-256-GCM references, and strict rejection.
surfaces.riskArea: Secret substitution and cross-archive reference reuse

surfaces.label: Foundation decoder, Contacts adapter, and doctor
surfaces.notes: Reviewed fixed helpers, no shell, bounded IPC/output/deadlines, minimal decoder environment, class allowlist, bounded legacy parser, live-only Contacts, output validation, and read-only doctor. Doctor's fixed same-authority Contacts helper inherits the parent environment but has no environment-read or external-output sink.
surfaces.riskArea: Unsafe deserialization, subprocess abuse, identity leakage, or diagnostic mutation

surfaces.label: Privacy projection, results, errors, and diagnostics
surfaces.notes: Reviewed request-only tightening, full/redacted/aggregate projection, forbidden-field assertions before both result forms, safe error keys, grapheme-safe snippets, 4 MiB result ceiling, deterministic summaries, and metadata-only stderr diagnostics.

surfaces.label: Memory-only search and resource budgets
surfaces.notes: Reviewed SQLite :memory: indexing, lower-of-512-MiB-or-memory cap, footprint checks, exact/token/phrase/trigram and literal wildcard behavior, decoder serialization, worker deadlines, and query budgets.
surfaces.riskArea: Persistent sensitive indexes and denial of service

surfaces.label: Package and release supply chain
surfaces.notes: Reviewed signed direct-child evidence, exact parent and scan binding, protected attestations, digest checks, explicit ./release-artifact publication, npm provenance/OIDC, public byte comparison, separate Registry/GitHub jobs, and stable canary derivation. External mappings remain action-time prerequisites.

surfaces.label: Seven-tool API, client manifests, and documentation
surfaces.notes: Reviewed exactly seven read-only tools, schemas, installed entrypoint, Claude/Codex/Cursor metadata, Mac-local coverage, Android SMS/MMS/RCS boundary, privacy claims, copied/live behavior, and unsupported operations.
surfaces.riskArea: Unexpected write capability or misleading deployment contract
